cohort: Sixty anxious primiparous women admitted between October 2021 and September 2022 were randomly assigned to a study or control group.
finding: Rational emotive behavior therapy effectively alleviated prenatal anxiety, shortened labor duration, and improved overall delivery outcomes in anxious primiparous women.
mod_finding: Rational emotive behavior therapy significantly increased the spontaneous delivery rate and significantly decreased the cesarean section and forceps delivery rates.
